product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR, Alternative 2 Inch Deep Sized Bed Pillow Top, Comfort Pad, Fluffy Protector, Plush Cooling Extra Soft All-Season Mattress Topper, Queen, White
features: 100% Premium Microfiber Shell With Down Alternative Polyfill
SUBTLE SOFTNESS. With an ultra soft shell made of the finest 100% Microfiber and lofty Down Alternative Polyfill, this mattress topper excels in comfort.

PERFECT FIT. This Queen topper measures 60" x 80" and contains 157 oz of fill with a 2" gusset. The plush down alternative fill refreshes an older mattress, adding a luxurious pillow top softness while preserving the support of your foam or spring mattress. Our mattress topper provides exceptional comfort, while staying cooler than more bulky toppers

CLASSIC STYLE. Complete your bedroom set with Superior's collection of comforters, mattress protectors, blankets, and pillows. Our wide range of premium quality down alternative and memory foam bedding will make your bed so cozy, you'll never want to leave

EASE OF CARE. The baffle box construction, crafted with double needle stitching, prevents our fill from shifting. This beautiful mattress topper is machine washable, and can be tumble dried on low heat to re-fluff. We recommend removing all bedding promptly from dryer to reduce any wrinkling. Always follow care label instructions for best results
description: ***Grand Down is now Superior brand***Affordable Luxury Linens

Treat yourself to hotel comfort at home with this luxurious mattress topper. Adding a plush, lofty topper is the perfect way to revive an old mattress, or add comfort to a mattress that feels too firm, without compromising the support it provides. With two inches of fluffy white down alternative fill, this thick bed covering provides comfortable support and an extra layer of softness for a soothing night's sleep. Superior's premium Our lightweight microfiber cover and lofty down alternative fill allow air to circulate for a cooling, breathable bed. Whether it's summer or winter, this mattress topper makes the perfect addition to your bed collection!

We have been manufacturing fine linens for over 40 years. We make everything from comforters and mattress toppers, to towels and bath robes, sheets, duvets, pillowcases, and bedskirts, and even area rugs. Our wide range of colors, patterns, and price points ensures that every one of our customers will be able to find something they'll love. We are experts in manufacturing high quality textiles and pride ourselves on only producing the finest products.
